jess (product): Quick UX note — the row quick-actions (⋯) are overloaded. Users keep hitting deploy by accident when they just want a preview. Need a quicker, discoverable preview and better keyboard flow. anya (design): +1. Thinking an inline hover preview for mouse, and an explicit 'Preview' keyboard action in the kebab menu. Hover card should show a tiny model summary, perf badges, and version dropdown. matt (eng): Inline hover = extra API calls. We need to lazy fetch and cache previews per session. Also worried about server load for big teams. kevin (devex): We can gate preview fetch behind intersection observer + focus events. For keyboard: add a menu item with role="menuitem" and aria-controls pointing to the preview region. Example: ```html
``` amanda (a11y): Accessibility nits: tooltips need a short delay and be dismissible via Esc. If we open a preview panel, announce "Preview opened for {model name}" to screen readers. Avoid focus traps in small previews — focus should remain on the row unless user explicitly opens a modal. jess (product): Microcopy question: should the pin action read "Pin version" or "Lock to route"? People confused whether pin affects only compare view vs routing. anya (design): I prefer "Pin version" — it's simpler. If it's route-scoped we can surface route context in the tooltip: "Pinned to route: /api/generate". Also propose a tiny pinned badge state (mini thumbtack) inline. matt (eng): Backend already returns pinned_by_route boolean on model metadata, so we can show a different tooltip depending on scope. Implementation ETA: next sprint. kevin (devex): For keyboard nav: add a single keybinding (P) when row focused to toggle pin. Also suggest focus-visible style for the kebab menu to aid keyboard users. amanda (a11y): Keybinding OK if discoverable — add a mention in the row's accessible name, e.g., "Model X, focus, press P to pin" via aria-describedby. jess (product): Badge semantics: we currently show a yellow "perf" badge and a blue "cost" badge. People keep misreading yellow as warning. Can we rename/reshuffle? Maybe latency vs cost explicitly. anya (design): Rename to "Latency" and "Unit cost" and change yellow -> orange with clearer contrast label. Also tweak tooltip copy to show 95th percentile. matt (eng): We'll surface p95 latency and normalized cost. Backend name changes will be tracked in infra ticket #512. deploy-bot: nightly/build #2024 succeeded — staging web assets v3.18.0 deployed. :rocket: kevin (devex): Quick deploy CTA copy: "Try in playground" vs "Open playground"? I vote shorter: "Open playground". jess (product): "Open playground" LGTM. anya (design): I'll mock a hover card (compact) + focused kebab menu flow and share PNGs later today. Also include contrast checks for badge colors. amanda (a11y): For badge colors, target AA contrast against the row background. I can run an audit on the mock. matt (eng): Action items: 1) design mocks from @anya, 2) API flag for lazy preview and pinned_by_route handled in #512, 3) keyboard binding spec from @kevin, 4) accessibility check from @amanda. I'll pick up front-end work in sprint 24. jess (product): Thanks — sounds good. Let's keep the preview lightweight. If anyone has examples of inline previews from other apps, drop them here. :eyes:
